title: Enterprise Portfolio Data Analyst
description:
Thanks for your interest in Children's Mercy!

Do you envision finding a meaningful role with an inclusive and compassionate team? At Children’s Mercy, we believe in making a difference in the lives of all children and shining a light of hope to the patients and families we serve. Our employees make the difference, which is why we have been recognized by U.S. News & World Report as a top... pediatric hospital, for eleven consecutive years.

Children’s Mercy is in the heart of Kansas City – a metro abounding in cultural experiences, vibrant communities and thriving businesses. This is where our patients and families live, work and play. This is a community that has embraced our hospital and we strive to say thanks by giving back. As a leader in children’s health, we engage in meaningful programs and partnerships throughout the region so that we can improve the lives of children beyond the walls of our hospital.
Overview

The Enterprise Portfolio Data Analyst, reporting to the Portfolio Manager, will assist the organization in making data informed decisions surrounding project requests as well as monitoring the success of approved projects. Through partnership with end users and project requestors, the data analyst will identify metrics helping to move the needle of organizational KPIs.

At Children’s Mercy, we are committed to ensuring that everyone feels welcomed within our walls. A successful candidate for this position will join us as we strive to create a workplace that reflects the community we serve, as well as our core values of kindness, curiosity, inclusion, team and integrity.

Additionally, it’s important to us that we remain transparent with all potential job candidates. Because we value the safety of the patients and families we serve, as well as the Children’s Mercy staff, we want to let you know that the seasonal influenza and COVID-19 vaccines are a condition of employment for all employees in our organization. New employees must be willing to be vaccinated if found non-immune to measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) and chicken pox (varicella) and/or without evidence of tetanus, diphtheria, acellular pertussis (Tdap) vaccination since 2005. If you become a finalist for this position, and have any concerns about receiving these vaccines, medical and/or religious exemptions can be further discussed with Human Resources.
Responsibilities
• Data exploration, project metric development data analysis
• Research and identify organizational data sources to support metric development and tracking
• Act as the data subject matter expert in the EPMO connecting people, tools, and data sets to facilitate data driven decision making

• Explore year-over-year milestone setting with requesters and help align milestones and metrics to industry standards
• Remain up-to-date on industry data analytical innovations and data use best practices
• Work with intake analysts to ensure project metrics have been developed and included in project proposals
• Through partnership with end users and project requesters, the data analyst will identify metrics which help move the needle of organizational KPIs.
• Project Metric Development
• Assist project requestersin pulling current state relevant metrics
• Work with EPMO leadership to define, build and track performance metrics to measure the efficacy and efficiency of EPMO processes.
• Work with EPMO staff and requesters to define, build and track project level metrics to measure project level of success and inform project status.
• Assist project requestersin analyzing current state data and setting yearly targets for improvement
• Provide updated data for program and project looks backs (in collaboration with program and project managers) as directed by Portfolio Manager
• Develop visualizations/dashboards depicting metric progress per project
• Liase between EPMO and finance team to ensure financial metrics are on track
• Synthesize and analyze data sets to present to stakeholders and EPMO leadership
• Project requester/ end user education
• Provide education to project requesters on tools leading to self-service data pulling
• Educate end users on the importance of tracking metrics and how to set yearly targets based on historical/contextual data
• Communicate to stakeholders if yearly targets are not on track to be met
Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree Required and 3-5 years experience knowledge of modern analytic tools, stakeholder management, project management, data analysis business analysis, business case development.
Starting Pay

Our pay ranges are market competitive. The pay range for this job begins at $27.87/hr, but your offer will be determined based on your education and experience.

Remote Work/Work from Home

This is an intermittent remote position, which means that the person hired will work with his or her manager to determine a schedule that includes both at home and on-site hours at a Children’s Mercy location. The incumbent must live in the Kansas City metro area.

EEO Employer/Disabled/Vet

Children’s Mercy hires individuals based on their job skills, expertise and ability to maintain professional relationships with fellow employees, patients, parents and visitors. A personal interview, formal education and training, previous work experience, references and a criminal background investigation all are factors used to select the best candidates. The hospital does not discriminate against prospective or current employees based on the race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, creed, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry or veteran status. A drug screen will be performed upon hire. Children’s Mercy is smoke and tobacco free.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

CM is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. Our patients and families come from all walks of life, and so do we. We know that our greatest strengths come from the people who make up our team so we hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes our hospital stronger and our patient care more compassionate.

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for service, you will find a home at CM. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring, including education, ideas, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability and beliefs

description:
The * Sr. Data Analyst, Marketing Operations * will report to the Director of Marketing Operations and is responsible for designing and creating key operational reporting and dashboards for marketing execution and customer communication delivery processes. This role will be critical for defining and building metrics that enable the team to measure and improve capacity planning, backlog... prioritization, execution SLAs, deliverable quality, and budget tracking. This is a terrific opportunity to drive tangible changes that will improve our speed to market, maximize business value, and ensure quality implementations of the 550M+ customer communications we send annually.

There is an ongoing need to prioritize and assign the work as an integral part of the campaign planning function. The reporting provided by this role will ensure efficient use of vendor services and internal delivery capacity (Execution, Targeting, CommsTech, Technology, and Analytics). • Data drives results: This role is critical to identify and bring forward workflow efficiencies and opportunities for improvements through operational data results and trends
• Partners with leaders and key stakeholders to research and design metrics that will effectively measure delivery capacity, efficiency, SLAs, quality, budget, and other key operational areas
• Identifies data sources required to produce operational metrics; develops database logic to extract required information for reporting
• Designs, implements, and automates dashboards and reports to facilitate data review and analysis
• Ongoing monitoring and reporting on team and vendor capacity, allowing prioritization and/or resource readiness
• Ongoing monitoring and reporting on cross communication efforts and orchestration effectiveness (Identifies areas of improvement for optimal customers experiences as they relate to communications they receive orchestration tracking, optimization should result in lower comms deployments, but higher engagement)
• Maintains reporting on daily project execution, monitoring on time, delayed, and cancelled (with dispositioning reasons)
• Creates internal operational reports for team, tracking productivity instrumental in goal defining and setting
• Supports efforts to distill data and reporting data into meaningful and actionable insights
• Ensures data availability and proactively communicates with clients on data delays and issues; triage upstream systems and databases for issues and partners with technology teams to facilitate resolution
• Requirements *
• Minimum *
• BA/BS degree and 4 years of related experience, OR MS degree and 2 years of related experience, OR Ph.D and up to 1 years of related experience OR High school diploma/GED and 8 years of related experience
• Experience in database languages and business intelligence tools (Oracle SQL, Tableau, MicroStrategy, etc.); exposure to collaborative work management tools preferred (Workfront, Jira, etc.)
• Creative thinker offering innovative and out-of-the-box solutions to complex and ambiguous problems
• Ability to independently execute analysis process and deliver actionable insights to the organization
• Effective communication and presentation skills with the ability to successfully comprehend and communicate business insights and resulting implications to non-technical business partners and leaders
• Demonstrated ability to work with a sense of urgency
• Strong work ethic with the ability to adapt to situations, be flexible, resourceful, and nimble in terms of work planning, and the ability to think quickly on your feet
• Ability to foster and work in an inclusive environment
• Preferred *
• Bachelors degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, related discipline
• Experience in the telecommunications industry

Here at Blue Shield of California, we are striving to make a positive change across our industry and the communities we live in - join us

Your Role

The Data Analyst team will be responsible for performing detailed data analysis, source to target designs, data profiling, and metadata management in support of new development /implementation or enhancement of existing data assets. The Senior Data Analyst will report to the Manager - Data Analyst. In this role, you will participate in designing, developing, and implementing large enterprise data warehouse/BI solutions. In addition, you will support operations and assist with production, and incident resolution. This position requires strong collaboration with a cross-functional team consisting of business system analysts, business partners, third-party vendors, solution leads, data modelers, analysts, and development teams. The analysts will be responsible for understanding business requirements, researching/analyzing requirements and understanding datasets that support business functions, conducting data profiling, provide the appropriate source to target transformations rules/logic for the implementation. Data Analysts are expected to integral part of the full development lifecycle process from concept, design, and development through testing, and implementation.

Your Work

In this role, you will:
• Be responsible for performing data analysis which includes inspecting, profiling, and transforming with the goal of discovering useful information, suggesting conclusions, and supporting decision making
• Perform data analysis, gap and impact analysis for medium to large-sized assignments (with med/large number of data elements, one-to-multiple sources, business impact, and visibility)
• Use documented procedures to create a source-to-target mapping, document code map capturing business and technical metadata, and complete data linkage
• Perform data profiling, present findings to various audiences, and propose options
• Perform ad-hoc, live research to demonstrate/present data issues, patterns, relationships, findings, and/or recommendations
• Partner with Business Subject Matter Experts, Business System Analysts, Solution Technical Leads, Data/Application architects, and development teams to analyze data requirements to ensure data design is aligned with business strategy, project, and scope
• Highly proficient in SQL skills with the ability to manipulate and analyze high-volume, high-dimensionality data from various sources using a variety of tools and data analysis techniques
• Ability to perform ad hoc, live research to demonstrate/present data issues, patterns, relationships, findings and/or recommendations, risks, and assumptions
• Ability to work with cross-functional teams: data stewards, architects, data governance, data modeler, data quality, development, solution leads, and QA team to address data and mapping questions

• Actively collaborate with others on business rules underlying the data
• Develop in-depth understanding and knowledge about the variety of data stores, data sources, applications and tiers that make up the DEERS architecture
• Design and administer data collection tools; clean, merge and manage existing data sets as well as establish and maintain data quality procedures to ensure accuracy and timeliness of data

• Minimum of a DMDC Public Trust or active DoD clearance (no exceptions)

• Ability to apply consistent quality and security standards.

Do you like to translate ambiguous business problems into questions that can be answered by leveraging analytical approaches and techniques? This position might be for you

What You’ll Do
• Develop a strong understanding of the Edward Jones Solutions-Based Approach to ensure that insights derived from analyses are actionable and relevant
• Help solve strategic challenges facing the firm through data using various technologies, languages, and analytical methods to provide actionable insights that support business decisions.
• Analyze the effectiveness of programs, summarize and present data to enhance future efforts using appropriate statistical methods.
• Develop business relationships and partnerships with cross-functional targeted business owners and senior leaders across the organization.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams of various areas of expertise across the firm in order to complete analytics projects that support divisional and firm-wide business objectives
• Learn from other team members, associates, and leaders across the firm on data and statistical concepts and best practices.

Firm Analytics partners with business areas to provide analytical and financial insights for firm decision making and strategic planning. We use advanced data manipulation techniques, data visualization and statistical analysis to provide actionable insights to the enterprise.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design and execute measures, KPIs and descriptive analytic analysis by leveraging business acumen and analytic acumen.
• Design and develop technical and functional prototypes to uncover business questions, validate use cases and capture key requirements.
• Query, manipulate and validate data across multiple domains using database technologies and querying languages (SQL, Snowflake etc.)
• Analyze the effectiveness of programs, perform calculations, summarize, and present insights to enhance future efforts using appropriate descriptive statistical methods.
• Conduct meaningful descriptive data analysis to inform business decisions. Primarily by performing root cause, exploratory, sensitivity and scenario analysis, hypothesis testing, economic modeling, and data visualization to identify patterns/trends/insights etc. on ambiguous business problems.
• Create data visualizations that simplify complex information in a robust, accurate, and appealing visual story that engages end users and drives them to action.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams responsible for implementing projects in support of divisional and firm-wide business objectives; occasionally lead cross-functional teams responsible for divisional objectives while following an analytics development lifecycle.
• Communicate across a wide range of audiences with specialized subject matter expertise including Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Products, Branch Development, and Technology.
• Work with stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data & analytics to drive business outcomes.
• Proactively recommend improvement to processes and controls related to area responsibilities while quantifying the impact of changes for leaders.
• Maintain a good understanding of business objectives, key business drivers, strategies and priorities, to inform an analytic approach to address business questions.

Education Required:
• Bachelor’s Degree with an emphasis in finance, business, economics, data science, math, engineering or analytics preferred. Advanced degree is a plus. Relevant work experience will be considered,
Experience Required:
• 3 years+ business experience in marketing, finance, data analytics, or relevant field. Previous analytical related experience is preferred. Financial services industry experience is a plus
Functional knowledge:
• Strong analytical, critical, and systems thinking
• Prioritize and execute multiple tasks/projects and adjust to changing priorities with leader involvement
• Extract large amounts of data and perform analyses using various tools and techniques including explaining trends and using statistical techniques
• Effectively communicate with associates and leadership across the firm using verbal, written and presentation skills
• Gain understanding of the firm and how data impacts decision making in each functional area supported
• Works effectively both independently and in a team environment
Technical Qualifications:
• Knowledge of relational database theory and proficiency in writing and understanding complex SQL code (e.g. windows functions, defining parameters, loops)
• Coding using scripting languages such as but not limited to Python, R, and/or other statistical analysis tools
• Data visualization – Knowledge of tools such as Power BI & Tableau
• Microsoft Excel – experience using pivot tables, formulas, macros, charts/graphs
• Knowledge of data mining, ETL, API, and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Client Data Analyst II

Mosaic is a leading North American Integrated Agency, specialized in connecting with consumers through Experiential Marketing, B2B, Sales & Merchandising, and Shopper Marketing. At Mosaic, we are never satisfied with the status quo and are in constant search for new ideas and new ways to help our clients build their brands amidst the evolving dynamics of empowered consumers and leveraging new technologies.

 

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

 

The Incumbent(s) in this position should exhibit the following values:
• People Minded

– Must show dignity and respect to all people
• Integrity – Must exemplify the highest degree of ethical behavior
• Results Oriented – Must show passion, pride and commitment to succeed
• Trust – Must be honest, sincere and confident
• Teamwork – Must build trusting relationships
• Innovation – Must progress through a combination of creativity, common sense and vision
• Balance – Must maintain an optimistic attitude and keep perspective on what is important in life

Responsibilities:
• Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
• Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
• Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
• Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
• Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties research and implement best practices with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
• Leading the standardized measurement first strategy for clients and team leaders
• Report and present findings, including recommendations for go-to-market strategy
• Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
• Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
• Other assigned duties

Qualifications
• Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
• 3-5 years of related work experience
• 1-2 years of project management experience
• Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up

About Civica

Civica is a 501(c)(4) social welfare organization established in 2018 by health systems and philanthropies to reduce chronic generic drug shortages and related high prices in the United States. Civica is led by an experienced team of healthcare and pharmaceutical industry leaders...

Today, more than 55 health systems have joined Civica. They represent over 1,500 hospitals and one-third of all U.S. hospital beds. Since established, the #1 Policy for the Civica team has been “Do What Is in the Best Interest of Patients.” Civica’s manufacturing facility in Petersburg, Virginia, is the future home of affordable insulin and essential sterile injectable medicines. The facility is currently in late-stage construction and hiring for the site is well-underway.

Effectively communicate with associates and leadership across the firm using verbal, written and presentation skills

The Supportive Housing Network of New York (the Network) represents more than 200 nonprofit organizations that have created over 55,000 units of supportive housing across New York State. title: SENIOR DATA ANALYST
description:
The Senior Data Analyst is part of a core team that enables strategic decision making throughout the company. Strong verbal and written communication, with time management skills are key to success in this role. This role will be able to consume, process and analyze the largest household goods datasets in the world in collaboration with other analysts, investigators, and subject matter experts... The right candidate should be passionate about data and analytics with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.

The work location for this role is flexible if approved by UniGroup except this position may not be performed remotely from Colorado or California.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Advocates for improvements to data quality, security, and query performance that have impact across your data domain.
• Approves data model changes as a reviewer and code owner for specific data domains.
• Builds actionable insight for the business using data visualization tools. (We use QlikSense and ThoughtSpot)
• Builds close relationships with other functional teams to truly democratize data understanding and access.
• Cleans and models large quantities of raw, disorganized data using code-based tools. (We leverage DBT)
• Clearly and concisely communicates complex business logic, technical requirements, and design recommendations through iterative solutions.
• Collaborates on SQL code base, creating analysis and transformations. (We use Snowflake)
• Collaborates with business units across UniGroup in building self-service, dashboard, and reporting solutions to deliver useful analysis and strong data insights.
• Confidently delivers and explains data analytics methodologies and improvements with minimal guidance and support from other team members. Collaborate with the team on larger projects.
• Contributes to, implements, and maintains best practices and standards in functional areas (data warehousing, data modeling, coding, visualization, and analysis) keeping reliability, performance, scalability, security, automation, and versioning in mind.
• Effectively communicates and collaborates, including providing clear status updates.
• Engages in discussions of technical design and architecture recommendations.
• Explains trends across data sources, potential opportunities for growth or improvement, and data peculiarities to deliver descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, forecasting, and prescriptive data analysis.
• Follows and improves processes and workflows for maintaining high quality data and reporting.
• Helps to define and improve our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices for our data environment. Maintains and advocates these standards through code review.
• Implements data quality tests and continuously review, optimize, and refactor data models in order to expand our data environments with ready to analyze data.
• Influences and implements service level framework SLOs and SLAs for data sources and data services.
• Influences overall objectives and long-range goals of team.
• Owns the end to end process of being on-call including reading logs, diagnosing issues, verifying and implementing solutions, and otherwise providing data support for UniGroup team members.
• Participates in data quality process and other data auditing activities.
• Proactively works on the efficiency and capacity planning to set clear requirements and reduce the system resources usage to make compute queries cheaper.
• Provides mentorship for Junior and Intermediate Data Analysts on your team to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy.
• Solves technical problems of high scope and complexity.
• Turns learnings into repeatable actions by documenting work in the appropriate shared location.
• Performs a variety of other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:Education, License or Certification:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Communications, Psychology, Business or equivalent experience.

Experience:
• 3-6 years of experience as a Business/Data Analyst or in related field
• Minimum 6 years of experience with SQL writing required
• Comfortable working in a highly agile, iterative environment using Jira.
• Ability to work with Git and the command line preferred
• Experience with a variety of data sources. (Our data includes many custom and internal applications, as well as Google Analytics, HubSpot, and more.)
• Significant experience in SQL and DBT required
• Experience with performance and optimization problems, particularly at large scale, and a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent those problems.
• Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases.
• Knowledgeable about UniGroup’s architecture, APIs, and tech stake.
• Possesses a deep understanding of how data is created and transformed through the UniGroup ecosystem to drive business operations, customer experience, service usage, and data reporting capabilities.
• Project experience working with SQL, Python, R, or other methods to generate insights.
• Self-motivated, and self-managing, with strong organizational skills.
• Understand the code base extremely well to lead new data innovation and to spot inconsistencies and edge cases.
• Understands the full data lifecycle and our common frameworks so that data can be easily integrated, modeled, and analyzed for insights.

Position Summary:

At Edward Jones, our clients' interests come first and data about them drives all of our Marketing decisions. This Senior Data Analyst will deeply understand our business and our clients and will proactively use that knowledge to help shape our Marketing efforts and deliver business value. This senior analyst will deeply engage across Marketing and surface opportunities in our advertising, our digital tools, lead generation strategies and our content and quickly turn those opportunities into tests and then actions. This role requires someone who has proven experience making data-driven decisions that deliver business outcomes and excels at translating insights into tangible results that help us better attract and serve prospects and clients.

Essential Functions:
• Proactively identify, size, forecast and prioritize opportunities with medium to broad impact where analytics can inform Marketing strategies, segmentation and other tactics through advertising, digital tools, lead generation and content optimization.

• Deeply understand Marketing strategies, objectives and measures and apply business acumen to understand the business problem. Able to independently identify the appropriate analytic approach to solve the problem or and engage other data teams to do so. Provide mentorship and feedback to others on analytic approach and leverage systems thinking to connect work to other strategic initiatives.
• Merge, cleanse and transform complex data from multiple sources (i.e. first and third party data through internal client data and/or Google Analytics) as needed for analysis and modeling. Develop advanced logic to structure datasets for analysis.
• Lead team to generate and incorporate insights into a cohesive story that clearly addresses business questions and influences decision making. Effectively lead the creation and communication of tailored messages to influence senior leaders regarding analytic ideas, approach, key takeaways and actionable insights.
• Understand and apply intermediate to advanced statistical concepts.
• Apply critical thinking to pressure test and validate logic and outputs against known sources and understanding of business. Proactively identify data quality issues and collaborate with other subject matter experts to identify solutions.
• Serve as a technical and functional data subject matter expert.
• Consult on data and analytic requirements for database development and system changes.

Job Description

Xplor Pay, a division of Xplor Technologies, is seeking an organized and enthusiastic Business Analyst (BA) to join a growing Product team. In this role, you will work closely with engineering and a broad set of internal teams to implement features and enhancements on our Horizon settlement platform specifically supporting balancing, reconciliation, and settlement activities which are critical to our core processing business. You’ll partner closely with the Finance team to streamline the daily balancing and reconciliation framework, leading to increased precision, traceability, and control outcomes. To thrive in the role, you will need to develop a deep understanding of the core transaction lifecycle, take ownership of gathering business, customer, and system requirements, and identify enhancement opportunities. You will then assist in the design of solutions to address those needs which will be subsequently translated to development teams for delivery. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of the merchant acquiring payments ecosystem and reconciliation best practices, in addition to having experience with agile methodologies. This BA will work with technical teams as an important conduit in conveying business objectives when executing against the product roadmap sprint-over-sprint.

To succeed in this role, you will:
• Be proficient in product capabilities and exhibit clear and current knowledge of product enhancements and roadmaps.
• Continuously identify, quantify, and prioritize opportunities to eliminate manual operational tasks to improve workflow and efficiency, particularly on issues that pose financial risk to the organization.
• Possess an analytical mindset with a curiosity to resolve reconciliation discrepancies and identify opportunities to prevent out of balance conditions, particularly related to complex financial transactions that flow through the full transaction lifecycle (e.g., authorization, clearing, settlement, refunds, rejects, reversals, disputes, etc.) where funds flow through and to multiple parties.
• Be comfortable working with large data sets for troubleshooting and research, creating visualizations to tell the story of your findings and drive concepts for future enhancements or resolution of current irregularities.
• Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders and other end users to identify and document pertinent product business requirements, in addition to leveraging data analytics and market trends to develop thorough and concise requirements in the form of a Business Requirements Document (BRD).
• Create supporting materials such as workflow diagrams and wireframes to effectively communicate business objectives, concepts, requirements, and acceptance criteria to a technical development team ensuring successful end-to-end delivery of solutions.
• Lead discussions on current and desired end-states, applying a deep understanding of data and technology design, and determining key decision points.
• Ensure high quality of requirements to drive more accurately sized user stories to increase confidence and alignment of delivery milestones.
• Perform business requirement Acceptance Testing as a quality gate, confirm feature and functionality testing for designated area of focus.
• Analyze and provide continuous recommendations on business solution design.
• Participate in agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and and refinement.
• Work with product management on release planning and create internal product release notes and documentation for dissemination.
• Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and scrum teams to prioritize the backlog and monitor deliverables to ensure delivery on the overarching strategy, roadmap, and milestones.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
• 2-5 years of professional experience in business analysis, finance, reconciliation, or related field
• Advanced data analysis skills and expertise
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Demonstratable critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills
• Outstanding relationship building and negotiation skills
• Solid multi-tasking and organizational skills with acute attention to detail

· Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in a relevant area of study with a preference for Information Security, Computer Science or Computer Engineering
· 2-3+ years of previous Security Operations Centre with experience and experience in conducting security investigations
· Strong knowledge of Security Incident Management, Vulnerability and Penetration Processes
· Information Security professional designations such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+
· Solid understanding of IT, including multiple operating systems and system administration skills (Windows, MacOS, Linux, Mobile)

Greater Good – We think beyond our own interests and strive to improve communities around the world. This demonstrates our passion for making a difference in the world.

description:
About OncoHealth

OncoHealth is a leading digital health company dedicated to helping health plans, employers, providers, patients, and life science researchers navigate the physical, mental, and financial complexities of cancer through technology enabled services and real-world data analytics. Supporting more than 7 million people in the US and Puerto Rico, OncoHealth offers digital solutions... for treatment review, real-world evidence, and virtual care across all cancer types.

About the Role

The Principal Data Analyst will be responsible for developing methods and algorithms to advance research-readiness of OncoHealth’s Real World Data asset. This role will work across departments and deliver results through research and collaboration with clinicians, data leads and client solution leads.
• You will directly support data, business, and other strategic and operational priorities for the department
• Develop methods and create new variables using claims, prior authorization, and other clinical data to enhance the research capabilities of OncoHealth’s Real World Data asset
• Develop and maintain data models for Life Sciences analytics products such as Oncology Insights and Dash IO
• Collaborate with Analytics teams in designing and documenting methodology for various clinical algorithms such as risk scores, RECIST criteria, regimen and line of therapy models, time to treatment, survival analysis, etc. with an eye towards augmenting real-world data offerings for Life Sciences
• Participate in data modeling and integration projects to expand OncoHealth’s Real World Data offering, working closely with NLP, Data Development, DataOps, and Analytics teams
• Contribute towards data quality improvement by developing tools for continual monitoring of data; detect and communicate data deficiencies and anomalies to internal and external stakeholders in a timely manner
• Establish and/or follow best practices for documentation and dissemination of information, including presentations to internal and external audiences, on methods, volume trends and resulting impacts on data and analytics
• Establish and/or follow best practices for documentation and dissemination of information on Real World Data, volume trends and impact on data and analytics
• Follow best practice for data quality and governance and ensure high-quality data is collected
• Provide quality assurance of data and results
• Embed proper security protocols within all data, workflows, and reports
• Engage in code reviews and process improvement exercises
• Operationalize methods and algorithms by collaborating with other teams to drive customer experience, improve clinical/operational/engineering workflow, and track growth and value-based performance
• Work with Analytics and DataOps teams to consolidate and centralize availability of algorithmic variables via data factory operations workflow

About You
• Bachelor's degree required, preferably in health informatics, biological or quantitative field
• Experience: 7+ years of analytic experience in Life Sciences industry using healthcare claims data or clinical/EMR data is required
• Experience must include longitudinal patient data analyses
• The right candidate would have a deep understanding of pharmacological interventions, resource utilization algorithms, outcomes studies or other similar use cases with clinical data
• Expert level knowledge of various clinical data vocabularies, such as, NDC, CPT, ICD, LOINC, etc. is required
• Demonstrated organization, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills with a keen attention to details
• Systems/Tools: Strong SQL skills, Python, Databricks, Visio, MS Office Suite advanced

About the Location

OncoHealth is committed to remote, hybrid or in office work options. The majority of the team will be remote or in hybrid work arrangements with offices in Atlanta, GA, Plantation, FL and Guaynabo, PR. We are open to employees nationwide, but work primarily in the Eastern and Central Time Zones.

Our Culture

Taking ownership of quick action, critically thinking through the needs, and working well with others are key competencies of team member success. Our leadership is dedicated to building a culture based on respect, clinical excellence, innovation – all with a focused mission of putting patients first!

We offer a full benefit package on your first day, along with a company bonus. You may visit or work from our very modern and engaging offices, and experience a fun, collaborative environment where social activities and community events matter. We enjoy being together!

The Opportunity

The cost of cancer related medical services and prescription drugs in the United States is expected to reach $246 billion by 2030. OncoHealth has enjoyed rapid growth over the past 3 years and seeks smart, collaborative people to join its team. We have just under 250 team members, so we can move swiftly but precisely to the market needs of our customers. Strongly backed financially by Arsenal Capital Partners & McKesson Corporation, we remain in an investment and growth mode. This means we are open-minded to how we get the work done – now is the perfect time to talk to us!

Our Current Solutions

Through the use of OncoHealth's utilization management system, OneUM, our customers can use a single e-Prior Authorization portal for all oncology drug request and treatments. Our system improves quality of care, reduces provider abrasion and gives health plans visibility into the total cost of oncology treatment.

OncoHealth offers Oncology Insights Pro, an analytic software solution that enables health plans to use data and analytics to improve oncology programs. Using real world data, our engineers normalize data to create analytic dashboards with drill down compatibilities. The data is the paired with expert guidance providing the strategies an insight needed to keep up with the continuing evolving cancer treatment landscape.

OncoHealth offers Pharmacy Consulting services to health plans and pharmaceutical companies. New cancer treatments are entering the market at an unrelenting pace. Since 2018, the FDA approved 121 new cancer applications including 49 novel cancer drug entities. Our Board-Certified Oncology Pharmacologists can help health plans update drug policies, offer utilization management and formulary advice, and development training for staff.

OncoHealth's latest offering is Iris, a digital telehealth platform that delivers personalized, oncology-specific support to navigate the physical symptoms and emotional challenges caused by cancer and cancer treatment. Powered by technology, staffed 24X7, and delivered with empathy, Iris allows patients to connect with trained oncology experts and receive personalized, oncology-specific telehealth support

Kiva (kiva.org) is an international nonprofit with a mission to expand financial access to help underserved communities thrive. Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst to join our expanding Data Analytics team. You’ll be joining a lean data-obsessed analytics team supporting stakeholders who are constantly on the hunt for impactful insights. This role will be responsible for delivering customer-focused data insights that inform the product roadmap and broader Kiva strategy, shedding light on key drivers of performance and growth, and developing Kiva’s product analytics roadmap. You will work closely with the product team to lead strategic efforts, define and measure success, and empower the team to achieve inspiringly ambitious impact goals. The role is fully remote (within the US).

• Use your statistical prowess to identify opportunities to engage
• Develop a robust product analytics framework by defining metrics, designing scalable product-specific data models, building critical company dashboards, and developing a core shared knowledge base.

• Provide leadership on a range of analytics work occurring across the company, including mentoring data users in support of self-service (we use Looker, but experience in any BI tool will help).

Preferred Qualifications
• 5+ years experience in product analytics, data analytics, business analytics, data science, economics, statistics or related field.

• Deep expertise working with clickstream/event data and metrics.
• Experience designing and evaluating statistical tests, including multivariate tests with non-binary outcome variables.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and executives.
• Familiarity communicating with and liaising between technical colleagues (Data Engineering, Machine Learning) as well as non-technical partners (User Research) and stakeholders (PMs).
• Comfortable extensively using BI tools (Looker preferred).
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and drive change.

What We Offer
• An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world
• Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues
• A comprehensive, industry-leading benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, generous PTO, and more.
• Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world
• The role is fully remote - you can work anywhere in the US.
• Colorado salary range: $140K- $150K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate’s location, skills and experience.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Lead the team in the 2 to 6 week planning horizon, managing the transit strategy and continuous improvement efforts. Collaborates with stakeholders to identify loss opportunities and priorities. Work closely with product and tech teams to conduct and/or coordinate discovery, design, and development efforts. About The Team

As a part of the Walmart Supply Chain organization, you will contribute to the success of our Transportation Network! Why? As the biggest player in the game, we trust our associates to innovate the future of Supply Chain!

Centrally controlling master data, optimization configuration and automation for our best-in-class transportation management systems is critical to enabling the business to meet customer demand efficiently and effectively. This team is at the crossroads of operations and technology to optimize transportation shipments for the best cost and service. • Collaborative analytics and project management to improve business operations.
• Data processing and data quality validation to ensure the best possible data inputs are driving systemic solutions.

You'll Make An Impact Through The Following Job Functions
• Advanced Analytics: In-depth investigation of key drivers of transportation dynamic optimization and data quality. Work with large, messy, disparate datasets and conduct ad hoc "back of the envelope" analyses to quickly inform critical business decisions. Develop data visualization to monitor and quantify the impact of changes and unique business challenges.
• Partnership and Collaboration: Engage with team members and cross-functional teams on a periodic basis and establish credibility. Analyze stakeholder needs and partner with them to share relevant information.
• Data and Data Processing: Leverage data analysis tools to explore and process complex data. Develop and test hypotheses, uses data to influence strategic work, builds and presents insights.
• Modeling: Develop and improve upon our methodology with A/B testing for continuous improvement of transportation shipment management. Execute on exploratory and scenario analysis to shape future changes and product improvements.
• Continuous Improvement: Seeks to implement ideas for process improvement for the group by leveraging lean manufacturing principles, time studies, and collaborative efforts with operations teams.

About You
• You understand transportation or supply chain, whether in Retail ecommerce environment or similar industries
• You are a problem solver and creative thinker: you think about finding the best solution that will work in days, instead of the perfect one that requires weeks.
• You learn and adapt quickly, and are excellent at working on multiple cross-functional projects concurrently
• You have excellent general modeling and data processing skills.
• You are customer-centric in spirit and in execution.

Beyond competitive pay, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include 401(k) match, stock purchase plan, paid maternity and parental leave, PTO, multiple health plans, and much more.

Join Walmart and your work could help over 275million global customers live better every week. Yes, we are the Fortune #1 company. But you'll quickly find we're a company who wants you to feel comfortable bringing your whole self to work. A career at Walmart is where the world's most complex challenges meet a kinder way of life. Our mission spreads far beyond the walls of our stores. Join us and you'll discover why we are a world leader in diversity and inclusion, sustainability, and community involvement. From day one, you'll be empowered and equipped to do the best work of your life.

description:
Company Description

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission...

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Palo Alto Networks is looking for a Route-To-Market Analyst to join its Strategic Analytics team to support its Partner Ecosystems organization. We are looking for a self-starter with excellent quantitative skills, a passion for advanced data analytics & automation, can tell a story through data & visualization , and a team-player with a collaborative mindset.

Job Description

Your Impact
• Become an expert in how to look at and analyze the company’s products, partners, customers, pipeline & key differentiators in Route-To-Market (RTM) to answer key questions and investigate complex business questions
• Partner with RTM leadership and executives with ad hoc analyses
• Drive the business forward by delivering high quality visualizations around key business metrics
• Partner with IT to build out certified datasets to streamline and standardize RTM data
• Support global analysis of RTM KPIs on a weekly, quarterly and annual basis

Skills

Qualifications
• High level of proficiency with Microsoft Excel
• Excellent presentation and written communication skills
• Ability to query and analyze large datasets and generate easily consumable reports
• Resourceful and proactive approach to problem solving
• Tableau or other data visualization tools experience
• Familiarity with Google BigQuery or other SQL languages is preferred
• Familiarity in working with GSuite, specifically GSheets and GSlides is preferred
• Salesforce and Tableau CRM (formerly Einstein Analytics) Dashboard building is a plus
• Understanding of backend databases, testing, and definitions is a plus

Education
• BA/BS in Math, Analytics, Statistics, Economics or related field
• 4+ years of related experience
• 2+ years of experience in data analysis

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. To learn more about our dedication to inclusion and innovation, visit our Life at Palo Alto Networks page and our diversity website.

title: Director - Data Analyst #LI-Remote
description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview...

Transaction Network Services is seeking a leader of its Data Analytics team to develop proactive reporting, insights, dashboards, and analysis for its industry leading call management suite of services. This position will work closely with product managers and data scientists to determine which data sets are needed and available for analyses and which data analyses to execute. Candidate will lead initiatives to design and build reporting tools, information dashboards, data generators, and other end-user information portals or resources. It will plan, manage and control the activities of a team of data analysts that provides technology-based data reporting tools and management for customers and internal management. The role advises business groups by providing technical and strategic reports that identify and address business issues and opportunities. In addition to producing dashboards and KPIs, the team will work with the data scientists to identify trends, test models, and develop learnings from the company’s vast data pool. The position must ensure that policies and procedures align with corporate vision. It selects, develops and evaluates personnel ensuring efficient operation of the function. This is a technical role focused on leading technical teams responsible for building technical tools and structures based on established specifications. The data to be analyzed consists of hundreds of billions of data points, principally telecom data associated with call activity, call authentication parameters, signaling events, and call routing databases.

Responsibilities
• Develop data set processes for data modeling, mining and production
• Acquire and prepare data for analytics purposes and assist with the execution of those analyses
• Design, construct, install, test and maintain data management systems, SQL, NoSQL, and Big Data
• Research opportunities for data acquisition and new uses for existing data
• Ensure data analytics systems meet business requirements and industry practices
• Build and assist with high-performance algorithms, prototypes, predictive models and proof of concepts
• Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures
• Employ a variety of languages and tools (e.g. scripting languages, R) to marry data and systems together
• Recommend ways to improve data reliability, efficiency and quality
• Collaborate with product architects, data architects, modelers and IT team members on project goals

Qualifications

Technical Skill Required:
• SQL, Python
• UNIX, Linux, Solaris and MS Windows
• SQL-based technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL and MySQL)
• Hadoop-based technologies (e.g. MapReduce, Hive)
• NoSQL technologies (e.g. HBase, SoLR)
• ERD Data modeling
• Data warehousing solutions
• Data mining
• Statistical analysis and modeling
• Database architectures

Nice To Have
• Predictive modeling, NLP and text analysis
• Machine Learning

Business Skills Required
• Creative Problem-Solving: Approaching data organization challenges with a clear eye on what is important; employing the right approach/methods to make the maximum use of time and human resources.
• Effective Collaboration: Carefully listening to management, data scientists and data architects to establish their needs.
• Intellectual Curiosity: Exploring new territories and finding creative and unusual ways to solve data management problems.
• Industry Knowledge: Understanding the way your chosen industry functions and how data can be collected, analyzed and utilized; maintaining flexibility in the face of big data developments.

6+ years experience with data driven technology

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Math or Statistics with a strong focus on data sciences/data modeling

description:
Summary

Come join a company that strives for Extraordinary People and Exceptional Performance! Chenega Enterprise Systems and Solutions, LLC, a Chenega Professional Services’ company, is looking for a Scientific Data Analyst I to support the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP), Epidemiology Research and Innovative Branch (ERIB). This... person will provide Data and Analytic Support by conducting and supporting the analyses needed to populate a social network analysis tool or other modeling activities. The Data Analysis I will create and submit SAS or R code to conduct statistical and epidemiological analyses and develop data request packages and scientific data approvals.

We are looking for creative, collaborative, experienced, and driven individuals to join our team!

Our company offers employees the opportunity to join a team where there is a robust employee benefits program, management engagement, quality leadership, an atmosphere of teamwork, recognition for performance, and promotion opportunities. We actively strive to channel our highly engaged employee’s knowledge, critical thinking, and determination to innovate scalable solutions for our clients.

Responsibilities
• Conduct and support the analyses needed to populate a social network analysis tool or other modelling activities, as requested. This includes working in conjunction with a current investigator to create code or analyses to be executed or included in mathematical models.
• Create and submit well-formatted and documented SAS code to conduct quality control and manipulation of data bases including merging, managing, and updating data; generating standard reports; performing data quality reviews; data editing/cleaning; and resolving data quality problems.
• Create and submit SAS or R code to conduct statistical and epidemiological analyses in support of CDC scientists including frequency analyses, 2X2 analyses, and logistic regression.
• Facilitate programming and data management analyses to draft and publish scientific papers.
• Prepare tables and charts for presentations and publications as well as develop data dictionaries and data management documents for studies working in conjunction with principal investigators.
• Apply analytic expertise to aid with new acquisitions and renewals of various administrative data sources by developing data request packages and scientific research approvals (e.g., through institutional review boards).
• Collaborate with diverse groups of epidemiologists, statisticians, programmers, medical officers, and project managers in response to data analytic requests related to ERIB’s programmatic mission.
• Perform day-to-day project management tasks to support ERIB led and supported projects, ensure objectives are accomplished. As necessary, recommend or take corrective action based on scientific and technical expertise.
• Participate in and/or coordinate meetings, conferences, 1-2 site visits, conference calls, webinars, and in-person meetings as needed.
• Review, edit, and draft scientific manuscripts for publication

Qualifications
• Two (2) to Four (4) years of relevant, direct comparable or similar work experience
• Completed Bachelors Degree or experience to substitute
• Professional working knowledge within SharePoint
• Professional interpersonal and computer skills, to include but not limited to, skills in operating Microsoft Office software, with emphasis on Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook as well as SharePoint.
• Skills in managing and prioritizing multiple assignments with strict deadlines and ability to coordinate efforts among many offices.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (both oral and written).
• Expertise to prepare and present information/data via oral briefing(s) and/or by written reports

Teleworking Permitted?

Yes

title: Data Quality Analyst II (Remote)
description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

Availity is a Healthcare IT company headquartered in Jacksonville, FL with an... office in Indianapolis, IN and a significant US based remote workforce. Availity is the nation’s largest health information network, connecting 2 million providers nationwide and processing more than 12 billion transactions a year, and growing! We work collaboratively with health plans and providers to disrupt an antiquated healthcare system by solving core issues in the way stakeholders communicate. Fixing the broken provider data management process and creating real time communication of risk and quality information are just two of the ways Availity is streamlining this process. Availity also offers providers, hospitals, and health systems revenue cycle and patient financial management solutions. We help prepare our providers for the rise in consumerism and value-based care, so that they can get paid accurately, and timely, for their services.

Our mission is to create connections and deliver products that help healthcare businesses succeed. We do this by connecting, delighting, and empowering the nation’s premier healthcare ecosystem; providing multi-stakeholder solutions that simplify the business relationship between providers and health plans.

The Data Quality Analyst II is responsible for ensuing data integrity and establishing repeatable processes to ensure high quality reporting standards within Availity. They will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders including product owners, data engineers, data architects, marketing, and sales teams, etc., to understand business needs, investigate data issues, and ensure reasonableness of reporting insights. They will assist in the development of documentation and automated testing to ensure data is accurately landed in the data warehouse from a variety of sources, and information is appropriately represented in the end-user reports.

They will work collaboratively to improve governance of data through inventory management, metadata capture, and development of quality control metrics. They will perform root cause analysis as data issues come up, work with appropriate teams to advise the scope of the issue and communicate the issue and resolution to impacted teams. This role is critical in empowering the wider development teams to provide better insights and analytics for our business.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Location: Remote, US

To Be Qualified For This Position, You
• Bachelor’s degree (preferably Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Management, or equivalent certifications)
• 2+ years of related experience scripting and data manipulation languages such as SQL and exposure to Python
• 2+ years of experience and proficiency in automating reporting and testing in tools such as Cognos, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Excel, or other related BI tools
• Perform triage, root cause analysis, and corrections to data issues reported by customers or exceptions reports
• Proficiency in relational databases; design, structure, data associations, and query language
• Experience in a strong data quality discipline and can bring best practices ideas for documentation and testing
• Experience in cross-examination of multiple data sources to identify the root cause of the issue in any data discrepancies
• Experience working on multiple projects with effective communication skills across various technical teams
• Able to plan work and coordinate own tasks in a fast-paced multi-disciplinary environment
• Proficient at triaging issues, identifying data abnormalities, and debugging software
• Flexible and able to embrace change

To Differentiate Yourself, You
• Experience in healthcare industry data such as X12, CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10
• Knowledge or experience in the health care analytics industry
• Experience in enterprise data catalog and development of data quality metrics
• Experience in migrating data platforms

What You Will Be Doing
• Identify opportunities for process improvement. Design, implement, and document the new workflow around data quality
• Liaise for the analytics team when data roadblocks have been identified, advocate for resolutions, track progress, and provide updates to the impacted parties
• Ensure newly generated data is mapped correctly to Data Mart, ODS, and/or Data Warehouse.
• Document data abnormalities and assist in the identification of their root causes, suggest possible steps for mitigation, and liaise with data steward to develop long-term solutions
• Assist in developing and documenting an enterprise data catalog
• Apply business acumen to develop data quality metrics and implement corresponding automated testing and alerts
• Work with the ETL Architect to handle, clean, and merge data using ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) standards and methodologies
• Work with engineering teams to enhance data model and optimize cloud computing performance
• Lead special projects as assigned to contribute to Availity’s overall business goals. Projects could include ad hoc reporting, searches and reviews, program evaluation, quality initiatives, analysis, development, etc.

Why You Want To Work On This Team
• This team operates together and individually to meet the customer’s needs. A team collaboration that has your back.
• This is a great opportunity for someone who has advanced SQL & Cloud experience and knowledge and is wanting to share the knowledge with others.
• This role works primarily with internal clients and provides great exposure to different teams within the organization on a daily basis.

Availity Culture And Benefits
• Availity is a certified “Great Place to Work”! Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!
• We have several Diversity & Inclusion teams, a Young Professionals Group, a She Can Code IT group for women in tech, and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates.
• Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack and in our industry that can help get you there too!
• Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.
• We offer a competitive salary, bonus structure, generous HSA company contribution, healthcare, vision, dental benefits and a 401k match program that you can take advantage of on day one!
• We offer unlimited PTO for salaried associates + 9 paid holidays. Hourly associates start at 19 days of PTO and go up from there with all the same holiday benefits.
• Interested in wellness? We allow our associates to reimburse up to $300/year for gym memberships, participation in racing events, weight management programs, etc.
• Interested in furthering your education? We offer education reimbursement!
• Availity offers Paid Parental Leave for both moms and dads, both birth parents and adoptive parents.
• Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with various organizations, both locally and nationally, to raise awareness, funds and morale as our staff members volunteer their time and funds to engage the organizations campaign.

Availity Perks For Remote, Hybrid And Office-based Associates
• We offer a flexible working environment! Whether you are a fully remote associate or one that enjoys a hybrid or fully onsite approach we are flexible to help ensure you have a working environment to thrive in!
• All associates have the opportunity to have 1on1 sessions with their supervisor or manager to help facilitate transparency and growth within the organization
• Availity holiday parties/events are available to ALL associates no matter if you are fully remote or have a hybrid or onsite schedule

• We appreciate work/life balance! Need to get a quick break in between meetings? We have Ping Pong, Foosball, Arcade games, and XBox to help you decompress – and we have a massage therapist onsite once a week for a little relaxation too
• We’ve got you covered with free coffee, lemonade and tea anytime you want

As a member of the Revenue Operations team, you will be responsible for providing data insights, reporting, and analysis across the organization. • Familiarity with reporting and analytic tools (e.g., Business Objects, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) DO NOT need hands on experience with these tools but need to understand the concepts from the business side.

This this role is for you!

Primary Purpose

This position will drive and lead the management of Finance master and reference data, making well thought-out decisions on complex or ambiguous data issues. This position works cross functionally with data domain owners and stewards in the execution of their data related responsibilities. This position requires focus on data strategy, and data management, as well as a familiarity with business finance and accounting functions to provide support for projects, programs, and operations. This role will also provide thought sharing at a global level. As a key member of the Finance Data Management Center of Excellence (COE), this position leads and/or participates in testing, implementation and on-going management of data related systems and capabilities such as data change pre-approval process, Stibo Mapping/X-Ref, issue management, error handling, testing error resolution, etc. In addition, this position will support ongoing data governance and stewardship operations, to include definition and implementation of policy and procedures, analyzing data issues, monitoring data quality, assisting in cataloging data elements, defining business terms, etc. Decisions influence the team’s effectiveness toward the overall planning, scheduling, and deliverables of the function and overall roadmap. Poor decisions have an impact on medium term business goals. Effective internal and external interactions, secured through strong influencing skills, are an important link in the communication chain of the business unit and contribute to the effective implementation of major projects and/or functional initiatives. Thinking is directed towards clearly defined objectives but requires solutions that build on industry and disciplinary best practice to improve current practice or result in the direct development of new procedures.

• Develops and executes broad reaching data management policies and procedures for review and approval by senior leadership. Decisions influence the team’s effectiveness toward the overall planning, scheduling, and deliverables of the function and overall roadmap. Poor decisions have an impact on medium term business goals. Effective internal and external interactions, secured through strong influencing skills, are an important link in the communication chain of the business unit and contribute to the effective implementation of major projects and/or functional initiatives. description:
Who We Are

RealPage is changing the technology real estate industry and our teammates know how to think big and leave their mark. If you want to join a globally progressive and inclusive company devoted to excellence, we are looking for you...

We are the leading global provider of software and data analytics to the real estate industry. We navigate clients toward the right decisions with data and technology insights they can only get from RealPage. Serving our clients is our highest priority and RealPage teammates are our greatest asset.

Come join a team where your work makes an impact every day!

About The Team

We’re passionate about helping hard-working entrepreneurs grow their property management businesses. We’re a collective of uniquely talented people who are at the top of our game and are determined to get better at what we do every day.

Our determination to make our customers’ lives better and break records is contagious—you find yourself becoming intensely passionate about the work that we do, even if the property management industry was never on your radar before you got here.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a data guru to join our Business Analytics team to assist the Mixed Use division by providing actionable insights regarding business operations, product features, and customer behaviors by retrieving, sanitizing and testing the data from the source. As a Business Analyst IV, you will report to the Director, Program Management Office and Business Analytics.

The Business Analytics team works with company management to define, collect and present the metrics used to make good decisions. The team is a collection of analysts that facilitate the network of data between our internal and external sources of data.

This role is geared toward someone who is passionate about asking and answering questions about the business through large data sets. A desire to provide actionable insights and experience with SQL coding is essential while knowledge in SaaS business metrics is a plus.

Primary Responsibilities

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to the following:
• Be the go-to analyst for the Mixed Use Team
• Develop a deep understanding of our intelligence platform and the sources of data that populate it.
• Coordinating with our offshore teamin India (intermediator)
• Complete ad-hoc analysis for business problems and present to stakeholders to provide actionable insights
• Assist with prioritization of incoming requests and manage team sprints
• Be at the core a team player, assisting other team members and helping them to learn
• Consistently deliver results on time and within the expected margin of task completion
• Responsible for Mixed Use analytics reporting working with various departments to provide business metrics
• Write SQL code to pull data from our database
• Build visualizations and dashboards

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities
• 3+ years analytics experience
• Proficiency with SQL
• Experience with Looker or other Business Intelligence tool
• Demonstrated ability to think analytically and solve problems
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, collaboration and influencing skills
• Experience working in a fast-paced environment
• Enthusiastic and goal oriented

Preferred Knowledge/Skills/Abilities
• Python/R experience preferred
• Experience working with a datawarehouse preferred

What We Offer

At RealPage, we’re always looking for talented professionals who thrive in a learning work environment that continually supports individual greatness. We foster a culture of innovation and creativity. It is the things you do that bring out the best of you and RealPage.

RealPage considers qualified applicants without regard to gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, race, national origin, age, veteran, or disability status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive work environment where all teammates feel a sense of belonging while bringing their authentic self to the table and being valued for it

SCALE Healthcare is seeking to hire a driven and dynamic Data Analyst to join our Revenue Cycle Management Team. SCALE encourages recent graduates as well as those with 1 year of experience to apply.
